title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Work IQ APIs billed pay-as-you-go in Copilot Credits
summary: The briefing's billing, licensing, default state and control paths are supported by Microsoft's documentation and the roadmap record. Minor corrections should clarify how overlapping policies are selected and note that the billing-method checklist step has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: Excluding Work IQ API from one policy does not exclude it from other policies, including the default policy.
claims.quote: Review all applicable policies, including the default policy. Excluding a service from one policy doesn't exclude it from other policies.

claims.claim: For overlapping policies for the same service, the policy with the highest per-user limit applies.
claims.quote: 1. Highest per-user limit 2. If tied, the largest overall policy limit 3. If still tied, the most recently created policy. If a policy doesn't have a per-user limit set, the system uses its overall policy limit as the per-user value for this comparison.
claims.fix: Replace the policy-selection sentence with: 'For the same service, the policy with the highest per-user limit applies; a policy without a per-user limit uses its overall policy limit for this comparison. Ties go to the largest overall policy limit, then the most recently created policy.' Keep the existing statement that settings are not combined. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/usage-based-billing-manage-copilot-credits#users-in-multiple-policies.

claims.claim: The chosen spending policy applies in full rather than combining settings from other policies.
claims.quote: The chosen policy applies in full and settings from other policies aren't combined.
